targets.query:
from(bucket: "batch_job")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => 
       r._field == "write_count" and 
       r.svc_name == "$svc_name" and 
       r.svc_env == "$svc_env" and 
       contains(value: r._measurement, set: ${job_name:json})
  )
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${interval}, fn: sum)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      job: r._measurement
  }))
  |> keep(columns: ["job", "_value", "_time"])
  |> group(columns: ["job"])

panels.description: The Maximum Number Of Write Operations for Batch Job Execution

targets.query:
from(bucket: "batch_job")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (r._field == "job_start_time" or r._field == "write_count") and r.svc_name == "$svc_name" and r.svc_env == "$svc_env") 
  |> pivot(
    rowKey: ["_time", "_measurement"], 
    columnKey: ["_field"], 
    valueColumn: "_value"
  )
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: time(v: r.job_start_time),
      _value: float(v: r.write_count),
      job: r._measurement
  }))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.job, set: ${job_name:json})) 
  |> group(columns: ["job"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: ${interval}, fn: max)
  |> yield(name: "commit_sum_over_job_start_time")

list.definition:
from(bucket: "batch_job")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.svc_env == "${svc_env}" and r.svc_name == "${svc_name}")
  |> keep(columns: ["svc_domain", "svc_name"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      r with
      cluster:
        if r.svc_name == "pr" then "cluster-prod-a"
        else if r.svc_domain == "prod" then "cluster-prod-b"
        else "cluster-nonprod"
  }))
  |> group(columns: [])
  |> distinct(column: "cluster")
  |> sort(columns: ["cluster"])
